jobs.title: Security Data Engineer
jobs.description:
The Security Technology Engineering team is responsible for collaborating and partnering with various Business Units (BUs) and stakeholders across the organization to manage external and insider threat detection, mitigation, investigation and response efforts across the organization. The Lead Info Security Engineer will participate in the activities of a global, expert team that develops robust technical solutions and advanced AI/ML capability to enable preventive threat detection efforts.

The cloud security Data-AI engineer works with our Cyber Engineering, Operations, Architecture and Global Infrastructure teams to deploy and operate a secure cloud application infrastructure that aligns with the Cyber security strategic initiatives and business needs. They will be responsible for engineer designs and maintaining data pipelines that extract, transform and load vulnerability, configuration and asset data at scale across heterogeneous environments, including cloud services and workloads, virtual machines, on-premises infrastructure, network devices and middleware.

The cloud security Data-AI engineer applies data science techniques to correlate and prioritize large, noisy vulnerability datasets, distinguishing genuine risk signals from background noise to produce actionable insights. The ideal candidate will be capable of querying and analyzing high-volume security datasets, including those generated by AI-enabled and modern scanning tools, to identify systemic exposure trends and emerging risk clusters.

The cloud security AI engineer is expected to maintain deep domain expertise in vulnerability data across asset classes, including an understanding of how exploitability, exposure and compensating controls differ by asset type.

The cloud security AI engineer evaluates and recommends defense-in-depth compensating controls across the technology stack — spanning network, API, ingress, application, OS/kernel and orchestration/control plane layers — to reduce risk where immediate remediation is not feasible.

They are expected to be self-starters, have a strong work ethic, leverage analytical and critical thinking and be resourceful in working as part of a global virtual team. The role also requires interfacing with other business units so the candidate must have strong verbal and written communication skills.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

Provides operations and engineering support for critical security systems and services including servers, endpoint security, computer forensics, vulnerability/penetration assessment/mitigation, and security event management.
Leads the cost/benefit evaluation of cloud solutions compared to virtual private networks, dedicated hosting, and in-house solutions.
Reviews technical feasibility of adopting external cloud based IT platform and infrastructure services within the organization.
Leads the identification of portions of the organization's IT platform/infrastructure with the highest potential return for cloud deployment.
Facilitates implementation of the organization's global strategies and initiatives to enhance Information Technology plans, operations and procedures.
Ensures the execution of vulnerability analysis and exploitation of applications, operating systems and networks.
Reports identified intrusion or incident paths and methods discovered through testing and evaluation procedures.
Designs, develops and implements countermeasures, systems integration and tools specific to cyber and information operations.
Resolves and documents complex malware and intrusion issues within the system as they occur.
Functions as an internal information security consultant on the standards, complex issues and best practices for the organization.
Conducts testing and analysis of complex software systems to determine both the functionality and intent of the systems.
Communicates with cybersecurity risk and security operation teams to enhance the overall security posture of the enterprise.
Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals to enhance their knowledge and performance related to information technology (IT) Security.

University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience

5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred

Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

5+ years of experience in Information Security or IT Technology.
3+yrs experience python coding
Experience in designing and maintaining data pipelines that extract, transform, and load vulnerability, configuration, and asset data at scale across heterogeneous environments, including cloud services and workloads, virtual machines, on-premises infrastructure, network devices, and middleware
Experience applying data science techniques to correlate and prioritize large, noisy vulnerability datasets, distinguishing genuine risk signals from background noise to produce actionable insights
Hands-on AWS cloud experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Degree in Computer Science or Data Science
Experience of querying and analyzing high-volume security datasets — including those generated by AI-enabled and modern scanning tools — to identify systemic exposure trends and emerging risk clusters
Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, GCP

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Ability to provide strong customer service.

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst, Index Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. 

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.  

Role Overview

Quantitative Analyst, Index Operations position sits within the Cboe Global Index (CGI) Operations team. In this role, the Analyst will support the day-to-day maintenance of the Cboe US Indices on a real time and end of day calculation, as well as the monitoring of index delivery and distribution in a timely and accurate manner. The team is responsible for data administration/QA, product sales support, product research and change-management activities for its U.S. Index business, including CGI’s theoretical options pricing service. The role will be primarily focused on derivatives-based strategies but will include US equity indices as well. This role will perform activities related to full operational support for daily index maintenance. The position will report to Sr. Manager of U.S. Index Operations.

Location:
Selected candidate must be willing to work in our Chicago

Your responsibilities will be:

Day-to-day responsibility for the smooth operation of U.S. Derivatives and Equity based Index calculation and dissemination in an accurate and timely manner
Timely resolution of issues in co-ordination with relevant third parties and internal Cboe departments
Perform periodic rebalances of Cboe US Indices in accordance with relevant timetables and provide client support related to rebalance events
Perform validation processes as documented in controls with appropriate evidencing and record-keeping, this includes daily index value reporting, corporate action and dividend monitoring
Follow the Incident Management Process after client impacting issues, ensure details are accurately logged, participate in the learning review and bring ideas for mitigating the risk of issues reoccurring or earlier detection of the issue.
Present ideas to automate and streamline index operation processes and develop tolling accordingly
Work collaboratively with other Cboe departments, third parties and vendors on new index launches and enhancements
Provide first class Client Support e.g., on-boarding, query handling and price challenges in a timely manner
Maintain and support detailed written standard operating procedures for daily processes
Record and maintain data for Key Performance Indicators, alerts and validation monitoring for potential errors in index calculations and dissemination
Participate in technical and methodological change-management processes related to index calculation and distribution
Run daily replication and calculation models and debug as needed within specific timeframes
Follow the Incident Management Process after client impacting issues, ensure details are accurately logged, participate in the learning review and bring ideas for mitigating the risk of issues reoccurring or earlier detection of the issue
Learn about theoretical options pricing and run basic modeling exercises
Performs other related duties as required or requested

Ideal candidate has:

Bachelor’s degree and at least 2 years of experience in financial markets or related field.
Derivatives experience a plus
Strong operational mindset and methodical approach to problem-solving
Intermediate experience working with R, Python, and/or other object-oriented programming language is a plus
Experience in solving complex modelling problems and “de-bugging”
Ability to interpret and apply mathematical index methodologies to real-world situations
Effective interpersonal and communication skills; solid writing skills is a must
Must be self-motivated and have the ability to work independently as well as part of a team, with proactive advancement of assigned work and problem solving.
Experience with MS-Office, particularly advanced skills with MS-Excel

Benefits And Perks Of Working For Cboe Global Markets

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement 
Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days 
Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 
2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire 
Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan  
Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation 
Employee referral bonus program  
Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities  

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include: 

Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office 
Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities 
Generous charitable giving company match 
Paid parental leave and fertility benefits  
On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers 

More About Cboe Global Markets

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people.  Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes. 

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on any legally protected characteristic, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or Veteran status. We are committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected.  

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $98,175-$144,375, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
DRW
is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW
is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The Data Analyst – Business Intelligence role will join DRW’s Unified Platform (UP) Data Management team. UP systems are responsible for data that spans the trade lifecycle: from research, execution, through to post-trade. Our business operations generate substantial data each day. Our global footprint produces inquiries from stakeholders that require complex answers. Questions can span years of data, multiple data stores and a variety of financial domains.

This is a reporting and analysis role at the intersection of finance, trading operations, and data engineering. The work is deadline-driven; your outputs go to regulatory authorities, external auditors, and firm leadership.

What You'll Do

Answer business questions with data

Build and run extracts against the firm's data stores to answer requests from the front office, and other units like Tax and Legal
Drive improvements to market share reporting and analytics
Support quarterly and annual tax and regulatory inquiries across multiple global jurisdictions
Respond to audit, litigation, and class-action data requests, often under short turnaround

Make the numbers trustworthy

Validate every extract before delivery — cross-foot detail against aggregates, reconcile against source systems, and investigate discrepancies rather than explaining them away
Document the business rules behind each report, including who made the decision and why

Reduce the recurring load

Identify patterns across incoming requests
Partner with engineering teams to translate those patterns into durable solutions: reporting dashboards, self-service views, scheduled reports
Write the specification: define the business logic, the edge cases, and the validation criteria that a tool needs to get right

What We're Looking For

Required

5+ years in a data analysis, business intelligence, financial reporting, or analytics engineering role
Advanced SQL — you are comfortable with complex multi-table joins, aggregation across different grains, CTEs, and reasoning about query performance.
Python for data work — pandas, database connectivity, and building repeatable scripts rather than one-off notebooks
Experience working with financial data: trades, positions, pricing, or reference data
Demonstrated care with accuracy.
Clear written communication — you'll be explaining methodology to accountants, lawyers, and auditors who don't read SQL
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field
Experience specifying requirements for engineering teams, or building BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Exposure to tax, VAT/GST, or regulatory reporting

The annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $130,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

new_jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst, Index Operations
new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world. 

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.  

Role Overview

Quantitative Analyst, Index Operations position sits within the Cboe Global Index (CGI) Operations team. In this role, the Analyst will support the day-to-day maintenance of the Cboe US Indices on a real time and end of day calculation, as well as the monitoring of index delivery and distribution in a timely and accurate manner. The team is responsible for data administration/QA, product sales support, product research and change-management activities for its U.S. Index business, including CGI’s theoretical options pricing service. The role will be primarily focused on derivatives-based strategies but will include US equity indices as well. This role will perform activities related to full operational support for daily index maintenance. The position will report to Sr. Manager of U.S. Index Operations.

Location:
Selected candidate must be willing to work in our Chicago

Your responsibilities will be:

Day-to-day responsibility for the smooth operation of U.S. Derivatives and Equity based Index calculation and dissemination in an accurate and timely manner
Timely resolution of issues in co-ordination with relevant third parties and internal Cboe departments
Perform periodic rebalances of Cboe US Indices in accordance with relevant timetables and provide client support related to rebalance events
Perform validation processes as documented in controls with appropriate evidencing and record-keeping, this includes daily index value reporting, corporate action and dividend monitoring
Follow the Incident Management Process after client impacting issues, ensure details are accurately logged, participate in the learning review and bring ideas for mitigating the risk of issues reoccurring or earlier detection of the issue.
Present ideas to automate and streamline index operation processes and develop tolling accordingly
Work collaboratively with other Cboe departments, third parties and vendors on new index launches and enhancements
Provide first class Client Support e.g., on-boarding, query handling and price challenges in a timely manner
Maintain and support detailed written standard operating procedures for daily processes
Record and maintain data for Key Performance Indicators, alerts and validation monitoring for potential errors in index calculations and dissemination
Participate in technical and methodological change-management processes related to index calculation and distribution
Run daily replication and calculation models and debug as needed within specific timeframes
Follow the Incident Management Process after client impacting issues, ensure details are accurately logged, participate in the learning review and bring ideas for mitigating the risk of issues reoccurring or earlier detection of the issue
Learn about theoretical options pricing and run basic modeling exercises
Performs other related duties as required or requested

Ideal candidate has:

Bachelor’s degree and at least 2 years of experience in financial markets or related field.
Derivatives experience a plus
Strong operational mindset and methodical approach to problem-solving
Intermediate experience working with R, Python, and/or other object-oriented programming language is a plus
Experience in solving complex modelling problems and “de-bugging”
Ability to interpret and apply mathematical index methodologies to real-world situations
Effective interpersonal and communication skills; solid writing skills is a must
Must be self-motivated and have the ability to work independently as well as part of a team, with proactive advancement of assigned work and problem solving.
Experience with MS-Office, particularly advanced skills with MS-Excel

Benefits And Perks Of Working For Cboe Global Markets

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement 
Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days 
Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 
2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire 
Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan  
Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation 
Employee referral bonus program  
Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities  

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include: 

Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office 
Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities 
Generous charitable giving company match 
Paid parental leave and fertility benefits  
On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers 

More About Cboe Global Markets

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people.  Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes. 

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on any legally protected characteristic, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or Veteran status. We are committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected.  

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $98,175-$144,375, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Additional information about Cboe's total rewards program, including benefits and other compensation components, can be found here: Total Rewards at CBOE.

Any communication from Cboe regarding this position will only come from a Cboe recruiter who has a @cboe.com email or via LinkedIn Recruiter. Cboe does not use any other third party communication tools for recruiting purposes.
